tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dhūpārtsanas+yātsāraḥpañtsadzātarutaswaranāmabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// bsang mchod kyi cho ga skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gauṇ+yaḥsaṃyuk+taman+yār+thamagromahāsaṃkalpas+yābatāraṃpratidzñānahi/ r+yasmāt+saṃsāradair+gh+yaṃhitodāranairābhogyaṃbhūtarat+nas+t+ribhiḥpālaya// ༄༅// che mchog yon tan ldan pa gzhan don du// 'jug par kun tu rtog pa'i dam bca' med// gang phyir 'khor ba srid du phan rgya che// lhun grub 'byung ba dkon mchog gsum gyis skyongs// 'dod dgongs snying po sgrub pa ci dang ci'i// gegs gyur nyams chag grib sogs mi mthun phyogs// legs sbyangs dag pa pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// bde legs bdud rtsi mngar po'i 'byung gnas yin// srid pa'i skyon las 'das dang srid pa'i mgron// ma lus mchod pa'i phreng bas mnyes byed pa'i// bsang tshul skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di// 'jig rten shis pa'i rang bzhin bsgrub phyir brtsam// de yi sbyor ba snod gtsang du// zan leb zlum po rim gsum steng*// dbus su dkon mchog spyi'i zlum gtor// g.yas g.yon chos skyong gzhi bdag gtor// bang rim bar par zur gsum dang*// zur bzhi zur lnga gcus gtor gnyis// sman zhal stod smad zur gsum bzhi// bdud mkhar zlum gtor 'dab gsum pa// 'bring chung gling bzhi'i gzugs dbyibs can// bang rim 'og mar rgyal srid bdun// bkra shis rtags sogs mchod pa'i phreng*// khyung 'brug seng ge g.yag lug sogs// mtha' skor kun tu mtheb kyu dang*// zan ril chang krad bcu res bskor// gzhan yang phye mar ja sogs dang*// rtsi shing sman gyi dud pa btang*// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed spyan drangs mchod// phrin las zhu zhing phywa g.yang dgug /rjes ni bzod gsol gshegs su gsol// bkra shis bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab bo// zhes pa ltar las/ sngon du mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa las gzi byin bskyed/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang rdzas dang mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur cig so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis skyon sbyangs/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās rgyas par spel/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ gis rang rang 'dod pa thob par byas/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na mas+sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi sam+bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya swā hās rang dbang thob par byas/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hās mgron mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ sngags de dag spro na lan gsum gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dang bcas te dharma ra ṇi/ sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ dge legs dpal gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// dkon mchog gsum la rtag par skyabs su mchi// 'gro 'dul kha lo sgyur mchog thob pa'i phyir// gtong ba chen po'i cho gar 'jug par bgyi// lan gsum brjod/ bdag bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥbadag nyid rgyal ba kun dngos spyan ras gzigs// dkar mdzes lang tsho'i snang ba bkrag po ches// rang gi mtshar sdug dum bu brkus dogs nas// pad+ma zla ba gdan du btings par nges// g.yas pa'i phyag gi mchog sbyin phyag rgya las// ci 'dod rtag tu 'jo bas dpag bsam shing*// stug po'i nags su bros snyam pad+ma dkar// g.yon pa'i phyag gi mdzub rtser dgod pa bzhin// srid gsum mdzes byed kun gyi snying po dag

/gcig tu spungs lta'i sna tshogs rgyan gos kyis// spras pa'i lha de'i spyi bor 'od dpag med// snying gar hrīḥyig dkar pos mtshan par gsal// thugs kar sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od zer glog gi bu mo grangs med 'phros// 'phags pa mchod cing rigs drug sems can gyi// sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba'i go 'phang bzhag /ma ṇi ci nus bzla'o// mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hrīḥrang gi snying ga las byung 'od kyi zer// phyogs bcu kun du song bas bla ma dang*// yi dam 'dren pa rgya mtsho 'khor gyi tshogs// dam can srung ma rnams dang srid pa'i lha// yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs bsang mgron du// gnyer 'os thams cad 'di na spyan 'dren gyi// pad+mas brgyan pa'i mtsho la ngang pa'i khyu// 'phur lding rtse 'jor rol ltar gshegs su gsol// gsal gdab cing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kye/ mdun gyi gnam sngon la chags seng ge'i khrir// bla ma brtan g.yo'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje dril bu 'gying bsnol rgyan khrol ler// sngo bsangs mtshan dpe'i snang bas 'jig rten 'gengs// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*// gsang sngags gsar rnying yi dam zhi dang khro// dus gsum dag gi sangs rgyas byang chub sems// rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos srung ma'i tshogs// srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po dregs byed dang*// gzhi bdag gnas bdag la sogs rang rang gi /cha lugs phan tshun ma 'dres ngom bzhin du// so sor 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ/ bcom ldan sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin stobs dang*// bdag gi mos pa smon lam stobs dag gis// sna tshogs mchod pa'i khyad par dpag yas sprin// kun gsal 'gram pa'i ngos yangs gtams gyur cig /kye/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i nyi ma 'dir// bsang mchod mgron du gnyer byas thams cad la// nyer spyod rnams dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// mi dbang rin chen bdun dang nye ba bdun// bkra shis rtags brgyad dga' tshal khrus kyi rdzing*// rin chen khang bzangs rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*// dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba la sogs// mkho dgu ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'bul// so sor mthun pa'i bshos bu ri bo'i sbun// spu sdug gom stabs mkhas pa'i g.yag lug ra// 'dab ldan ri dwags sder chags rnam pa mang*// ris su rtse 'jor rol zhing sgyu rtsal 'gran// gang bsam gnad du gcod 'bigs mtshon gyi rigs// rang srung shin tu sra brtan go khrab ber// rin chen 'bru dang gos dar dpag tu med// khyad par dri zhim bsang mchod 'bul ba ni// dar bab rtse dga'i ro de dpyid kyi bus// 'thung 'dod sprin gyi mgo 'phang rab btegs nas// dbyar dus mdza' na mo de 'brug gi sgra// dal bus 'bod cing rngul chu char du bsnyil// nam zhig dus kyi rgyal mo sngo bsangs mas// dbyar skyes lo 'dab stug po'i gos bzangs dang*// rnam bkra me tog sar pa'i do shal bklubs// khu byug bung ba'i glu dbyangs len gyin byung*// gang der btus pa'i phang phung lo 'dab dang*// me tog mañdza rīs mdzes bzang dgu'i shing*// tsan+dan a ga ru dang spos dkar sman// dkar gsum mngar gsum ja chang phye mar bsregs// de yi bsung gi du ris 'khyog po dag

/nam mkha'i ngos yangs 'dri bas nyes pa'i tshogs// legs sbyangs shel gyi kun dga' rwa ba bzhin// dri med shis pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa 'dis// srid zhi'i skyon bral dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la// glo bur nyes pas bsgrib par mi 'gyur yang*// bdag sogs nyams grib nyes ltung sbyang ba'i slad// 'dod yon lnga rdzogs sprin gyis bsang zhing mchod// kye/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang sde snod gsum// bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma yan lag bcas// mkhas tshul gsum gyis gsal mdzad dngos brgyud kyi// slob dpon mkhan por gyur pa thams cad bsang*// gangs can bstan pa'i snang byed zhi ba 'tsho// pad 'byung pad+ma'i ngang tshul mes dbon gsum// sa skya pa dang kun bzang blo bzang grags// zla 'od gzhon sogs mkhas pa'i mchog rnams bsang*// phan tshun lta dang 'dzum pa lag bcang dang*// zung sbyor rtse dga'i dga' ba lam slong ba// ches zab rgyud sde'i rim pas legs bstan pa'i// dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yi dam lha// dgyes pa rdo rje dus 'khor bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba 'dus pa dus dgra dmar nag 'jigs// sgrub pa bka' brgyad la sogs dkyil 'khor lha// rnam lnga'i rigs can lha yi tshogs rnams bsang*// rdul bral ye shes rnam lnga'i bdag nyid che// 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las// rang gi rigs mchog nges pa'i 'khor los sgyur// de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bcas dang*// 'dren pa gzhan gyis ma byon snyigs ma lnga'i// dus 'dir mngon par 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan pa// lha mi'i ston pa shākya seng ge sogs// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bsang*// tshig don bzang pos yongs dben sgrib gsum gyi// gnyen por mi byed tam+bu ra yi dbyangs// legs gsungs zegs ma'i char yang 'gran min pa'i// bstan pa dam pa'i chos tshul thams cad bsang*// snying stobs brtan pa'i phrag par sems can gyi// sdug bsngal dngos po'i khur chen khyer ba po// nye sras phyogs kyi glang po che brgyad dang*// mu med zhing gi sems dpa' che rnams bsang*// thub pa rang gi ye shes dgra bcom pa'i// nyan thos tshul gyis bstan pa skyong ba po// gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor bcas dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal ma lus bsang*// dam pa'i chos dang chos mdzad la sdang ba'i// bstan dgra'i snying khrag dron mo 'thung ba la// rngam pa'i zhal gdangs bla nas 'bod pa'i sgras// sa gsum g.yo ba srung ma'i sde dpon che// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// stobs 'phrog dbang po las byed mgon po'i tshogs// phyag bzhi phyag drug bing mgon re wa tī// dur khrod bdag po sha za 'khor bcas bsang*// las kyi gshin rje beg gdong lcam sring sde// ma ning nag po stag gzhon dkar bdud rgyal// legs ldan mched gsum trak+shad zhang blon sogs// bka' dang gter skyong dam can thams cad bsang*// rab dwangs sems rgyud zhing sa gshin po mar// sbyin pa'i sa bon ci yang btab las skyes// nor bdag slong ba'i dpag bsam rnam thos sras// rmugs 'dzin nor gyi rgyun ma 'khor bcas bsang*// 'od zer pad+ma rā ga'i 'ching thag des// khams gsum skye bo gang la btab tsam gyis// rang dbang byed pa'i 'dod rgyal rigs byed ma// tshogs bdag sha za'i mkha' 'gro gsum bcas bsang*// mkha' la spyod dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul// so gnyis gnas dang phyogs brgyad dur khrod du// sgyu 'phrul du mas sems can don bzhugs pa'i// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bsang*// pha mes mi rabs rgyud kyi srung ma dang*// rig 'dzin slob dpon rgyud kyi srung ma dang*// rang nyid rtag tu bsten cing mchod byas pa'i// ye shes 'jig rten srung ma'i tshogs rnams bsang*// thub pa'i bka' thos 'jig rten 'dir che yang*// chos mdzad bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub pa'i bran// phyogs skyong lha chen klu chen rgyu skar gza'// rgyal chen ris dang 'jigs byed che rnams bsang*// bskal pa'i bar dang gnam lo zla ba zhag

/dus tshod so sor dbang sgyur sa yi bdag /rje blon 'bangs su gtogs pa thams cad dang*// phyi nang 'byung bar dbang ba'i lha rnams bsang*// snang zhing srid pa'i lha dang gshin gyi rje// ma bdud btsan dang rgyal po gnod sbyin klu// gza' gdong gying sogs dregs pa'i sde tshogs dang*// bstan ma bcu gnyis tshe ring mched lnga bsang*// kye/ stong gsum 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag tu// gling rnams yongs kyi rgyal po 'dzam gling gi /dbus gyur 'chang ba rdo rje'i gdan la sogs// rgya gar li dang bal po rgya nag hor// gangs can bod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang*// dbus gtsang ru bzhi mdo stod mdo smad de// yul gru de dag so so'i gdags sribs kyi// gangs ri brag ri spang ri nags tshal klung*// sa gzhi 'bab pa'i chu dang lteng ka mtsho// 'brog dgon shing gcig slas dang nor bu'i gling*// grong khyer grong rdal tshong 'dus lam gyi srang*// sgrub gnas dkor khang gtsug lag khang rnams su// gnyug mar gnas pa'i yul lha dge bsnyen dang*// gzhi yi bdag po gnas kyi srung ma dang*// lha dang klu dang 'byung po gang dag gnas// bu smad 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa bsang*// mthu chen srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang*// yab lha gdal drug mgur lha bcu gsum dang*// ge khod sum brgya drug cu spom ra rma// thang lha yar bzhugs gnyan 'khor bcas pa bsang*// khyad par yul 'di'i nyen skor khor yug gi /sa chu rdo shing gnyan po gang dag tu// brten par bcas nas bde 'byor sgo 'phar 'bum// 'byed pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang*// kye/ bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mgon skyob dpung gnyen byed pa'i dgra lha dang*// dpa' rtsal mthu stobs skyed pa'i dgra lha dang*// smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dgra lha bsang*// legs ldan mgon po dgra lha'i dmag tshogs dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgra lha wer ma'i tshogs// dmu rabs btsug rabs mi'u gdung drug gi

/rgyud du 'go sogs srid pa'i dgra lha bsang*// mi 'chad rigs rgyud rnam par spel ba'i lha// mi 'bral lhan cig skyes dang skyob pa'i lha// mi shigs lus srog brtan par byed pa'i lha// mi nyams dbang thang klung skyed lha rnams bsang*// yul bzung srid kyi khur skyong mkhar khang brtsig /che sar dbang bskur tshong byed so nam rtsom// dmag gshom phyogs su don gnyer phyir bzhud pa'i// bya ba de de'i dpal skyed lha rnams bsang*// mkhar rdzong khang khyim sbra dang sgo yi lha// zhing lha thab lha zas bcud rme ba'i lha// gzhis kyi srung ma byes kyi lam lha sogs// bde 'byor sgrub pa srid pa'i lha rnams bsang*// chos dbyings mkha' la ye shes pir gyi rtser// 'khrungs pa'i ye shes lha ni bsam mi khyab// 'khor ba'i ngos gzhir kun rtog mdzub mo yis// bris pa'i 'jig rten lha yang bgrang du ci// des na rnam pa mang po'i ming gi rnga// ngag gi dbyig gus bskul bar ma nus kyang*// sbyin pa'i 'os gyur gang dag lhags pa rnams// 'dod yon bsang gi mchod pas tshim gyur cig /nyams grib bsang ba ni/ kye/ kun rdzob blo ngor snang ba'i nyes tshogs rnams// dag byed lha bsang dam pa'i cho ga yis// don dam 'khor gsum dmigs pa bral ba'i klong*// sgyu ma'i skyes bu rtse 'jor rol bzhin bsang*// bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyis// gang zhig thob pa sdom pa'i nor bu gsum// nyes ltung 'dam du bsgyur ba'i grib byung na// thugs rje che ldan rnams kyis sbyang du gsol// dme yugs ro dang mdze can nal gyi grib// bza' btung rgyan gos mi gtsang spyad pa'i grib// 'khor dang longs spyod mi shis bsten pa'i grib// mi dang lhar 'khon byad gtad bcug pa'i grib// phyi rol gdon gsum 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i grib// nang du nyon mongs dug gsum bdo ba'i grib// gsang bar sgrib gsum bag la zha ba'i grib// 'bras bu khams gsum sdug bsngal lci ba'i grib// de sogs gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba'i bcud// 'thung la bar du gcod pa'i mi gtsang grib// thams cad bsang mchod phul ba'i mthus dag pa// sprin bral zla ba lta bur gsal gyur cig

/phrin las zhu ba ni/ kye/ lha shing bzang dgu gtul ba dud pa'i sprin// bshams dang sprul pa'i 'dod yon gya nom pas// dbang lnga'i nor bu shel gyi mdzod thams cad// skad cig rer yang phyur bur 'gengs pa 'dis// bla ma dkon mchog gsum tshogs mnyes gyur nas// byin rlabs dngos grub gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin stsol// rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde tshogs mnyes gyur nas// rnal 'byor bsgo ba'i phrin las bran bzhin sgrubs// dbul ba'i gdung sel nor gyi lha mnyes nas// mi zad dbyig gi dngos grub char bzhin phob// yul lha dgra lha 'go ba'i lha mnyes nas// kha 'dzin rgyab brten brtse ba'i ma bzhin mdzod// thun mong dag tu mchod 'os khyed rnams kyis// grub mchog bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus pa'i sde// nor ldan brtan ma'i khur du lci bar mdzod// dpyad gsum lam du ma lus shes bya'i gnas// song ba ngo mtshar mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// kun dga'i dpal ster 'jig rten snying po de'i// lugs bzang bskal pa'i bar du rgyas par mdzod// bde gshegs bstan pa kun dga'i 'byung gnas su// rgyal tshab bzang po'i bgyi ba rmad byung gis// yid srub snying ni mya ngan chur bzhu ba'i// tshul chen smra bas sa stengs brgyan par mdzod// bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po mi phyugs bcas// 'gro 'dug gnas skabs kun tu gces pa'i bur// brtse ba'i mas bzhin nyes pa las skyob cing*// legs pa thams cad sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi bdag kha ru stob pa'i 'phrin// gdon bgegs 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i sbrul gyi sos// btab pa'i zug rngu nad dang bkres rngabs dang*// 'thab rtsod bskal pa zhi ba'i phrin las sgrubs// mi phyugs lus kyi stobs dang bde ba srog /'dzin pa'i nyer 'tshor gyur pa 'bras bu yi// ro bcud 'phrog pa'i nad bu btsa' then dang*// sad dang ser ba srung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// 'brug sgra lhod por 'khun pa'i sprin rum nas// ut+pal do shal thag pa chad 'dra'i char// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dus su bab las skyes// lo legs 'bru tshogs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// bsod nams lo 'dab gsar pas nyer bklubs pa'i// 'chi med tshe yi ljon pa rgyas pa'i phang*// dpal 'byor snye ma 'dzad pa med 'jo zhing*// grags pa'i me tog 'dzum pas mdzes par mdzod// dbang gi dmar mdangs yid 'phrog mkhur tshos su// 'phos pha'i phrin las 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis// stobs 'byor ldan pa'i yid kyi mdza' na bo// rtse gcig 'dun pa dbang gi phrin las mdzod// 'jigs 'jigs mngon spyod drag po'i mig gi mes// wal wal dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs mda' lnga pa// tshom tshom med par gzhob tu thul bsregs nas// yang yang srid pa med pa'i dbyings su sbyor// byang chub snying por mngon du phyogs pa'i blo// sgrub dka'i bslab gzhi thos pas mi zhum zhing*// bdud sde'i bslu thabs stong gis mi bzlog par// tshogs gnyis sgrub pa stobs su che mdzod cig

/ces brjod la gtor ma yul lha'i phyogs su gtong ngo*// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa ni/ kye/ g.yang du len no bung bas pad+ma'i bcud// yid 'phrog gzugs kyis mngon 'dod ldan pa'i yid// mchog gi rin chen gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus// gang dag bsam pa'i phywa g.yang thams cad do// sa gzhi chu gter lhun po gser gyi ri// gling dang gling phran lcags ri'i khor yug ste// kun gyi rten gyur snod kyi dpal 'byor g.yang*// thams cad bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len// legs bris bdag po rnams dang gdengs can dbang*// 'khor los sgyur sogs 'jig rten che ba dgu'i// rdzu 'phrul mthu dang yon tan bdun gyi g.yang*// thams cad bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len// 'phags dang so skye'i mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang*// rig 'dzin bden par smra sogs che mchog gi /mkhyen brtse nus pa 'phags nor bdun gyi g.yang*// thams cad bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len// mtho ba'i go 'phang yangs pa'i chab srid dang*// 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs mi 'chad rigs kyi rgyud// dpag yas phrin las snyan par grags pa'i g.yang*// thams cad bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len// bsang tshul skye ba lnga ba'i rdzas mchog gi /phrin las snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ldir ba'i khongs// rgud pa'i rims nad med par bkra shis pa'i// phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'khyil pa'i las mdzod cig /nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ kye/ 'jig rten dge legs legs byas sgrub pa'i tshul// tshul bzhin ma bshams bshams pa'i mthun rdzas dman// dman pa'i blos mchod mchod pa'i cho ga nyams// nyams chag de kun kun du bzod par rigs// gshegs su gsol ba ni/ mchod sbyin stob pa'i yul du gang byon pa// thams cad rab dga' rgyas pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis// 'di na shis pa yang dag bsgrubs nas ni// rang rang gnas su gshegs shig 'khor 'das mgron// bkra shis bya ba ni/

kye/ bla ma'i bkra shis gdugs ltar bsil ba ster// yi dam bkra shis dngos grub bum par 'jo// sangs rgyas bkra shis yon tan pad+ma rgyas// skyabs gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /chos kyi bkra shis dung dkar dbyangs su ldir// dge 'dun bkra shis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// chos skyong bkra shis phrin las 'khor los sgyur// mchog gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /nor lha'i bkra shis g.yang gi dpal be'u 'khyil// lha yi bkra shis dpal 'byor nya ltar che// mi yi bkra shis bsod nams dpag bsam rgyas// che gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam gang rigs brjod do// smras pa/ brjod bya mi nyung brjod tshul rgyan gyi lam// song ba'i ya mtshan blta phyir mtsho ldan ma// rgyud mangs glu ru brdzus nas 'ongs snyam du// yi ge'i tshogs rab gad mor dgod pa bzhin// chu gter 'gram nyul ngal ba ma myong zhing*// brten pa srog ldan bkums pa'i sdig med par// sdeb legs cho ga'i g.yas 'khyil dung dkar sgras// skal ba ngan pa'i rims nad bcad cing gtubs// rtag 'grus skal ldan shing rta'i dka' spyad kyis// legs par phab pa'i dge tshogs gaṅgā'i chus// lus can mi gtsang nyams chag sgrib sbyangs nas// bde 'byor legs bris dpal la spyod gyur cig /de ltar bsang mchod kyi cho ga skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag zung gi blo gros rnam par gsal ba'i dge slong dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis snga phyir bskul ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa'i rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bor tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ slob dpon pad+ma'i brgyags rngan dang bdag chen rgya gar pa'i bsang yig sogs mkhas mchog rnams kyi gsung don brjod byar byas nas ha cang rgyas dang bsdus mtha' dag tu ma lhung bar/

me stag lo'i tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bsang mchod bsdus pa bde legs nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ lha bsang bsdus pa khyer bde 'dir// dri zhim bsung btang bran ma thag /phyogs rnams kun tu bsang mgron gyis// khyab par dmigs nas 'di skad do// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs gsang gsum rdo rjes byin brlabs pa'i// 'dod dgu rtag 'jo dud pa'i sprin sngon 'dis// mdo rgyud bka' babs bla ma thams cad dang*// gsang sngags gsar rnying yi dam lha yi tshogs// rgyal ba sras slob kun dang chos skyong ba// nor sbyin 'jig rten srung ma dregs pa'i sde// 'dzam gling yul gru spyi dang ljongs 'di yi// gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'go ba'i lha srung rnams// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes pa'i rtser phyin nas// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nyes sgrib rnams// legs sbyangs bde bar 'tsho zhing bsam pa 'grub// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor 'khyil ba'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa'i bsang bsdus bde legs nyi// 'di yang dkon mchog dpal ldan ngor// ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis// thun mtshams shig tu bris so dge/ // ༄༅// kye rdo rje rgyud gsum lha tshogs srung mar bcas pa'i bsang tshul rdo rje glu ma'i dbyangs mchod ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dngos grub zung gi dpal ster bla ma dang*// gnyis min dgyes pa rdo rje la btud de// rgyud gsum lha bsangs rdo rje glu len ma'i// mgrin pa'i 'khor lo las skyes dbyangs mchod 'bul// 'di la 'jug par 'dod pas/ bsang rdzas mchod gtor ci 'byor ba bshams la/ thog mar spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ chos dbyings zab mo'i pha rol gang du phyin// de srid mnyam par brdal ba rang bzhin gyis// lhun grub sangs rgyas zhing khams dpag yas nas// srid zhi'i khyab bdag snying po kye rdo rje// sku gsung thugs sogs rgyud gsum lha yi tshogs// bla ma yi dam srung mas yongs bskor ba// bdag cag mos pas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// thugs rje smon lam dbang gis da tshur spyon// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

mdun gyi mkha' dbyings yon gnas mgron gyi mchog /zhi 'dzum khro chags rnam pa ci dang cir// snang yang bden min sgyu ma'i ltad mo bzhin// gzi byin lham mer so so'i gdan la bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ mi phyed rdo rje'i gur khyim rab yangs par// dbugs bral gar byed dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus// ye shes lnga mdangs rab gsal gzhal med khang*// mtshan nyid kun rdzogs thar pa'i grong mo che// de dbus chu skyes 'dab brgyad lte ba la// nyin byed bdud sde'i dbang po rnam bzhi'i steng*// 'bras ldan dus kyi mkha' mtshungs he ru ka /khros pa'i zhal brgyad skra yis mtshams sprin 'khrigs// bcu drug phyag gi thod pas sogs chags brgyad// len cing lha dbang brgyad po ster tshul bzung*// zhabs bzhis gar mdzad gang der mkha' 'gro'i gtso// sngo bsangs gri gug thod pa 'dzin mas 'khyud// gnyis ka'i sku la rab dkar rus pa'i rgyan// mngon par bklubs la grangs med rgyu skar phreng*// ma bzod skya rengs lam du bros snyam nas// mgo bo'i phreng dag rus pa'i ge sar dgod// 'dab brgyad zla bar shar phyogs tshangs pa'i gdan// gau rī nag mo gri gug gser mig thogs// lho phyogs dbang por rab dmar chom rkun ma// cang te'u snyan pa'i sgrar 'khrol phag pa bsnams// nub phyogs nye ba'i dbang por ro langs ma// 'dzam bu gser 'dra rus sbal thod pa 'dzin// byang phyogs drag po la gnas ghasma rī// ltos 'phye thod pas lag brel margad mdangs// byang shar gshin rje'i steng bzhugs sbos mo sngo// lag pa gdong lnga pa dang dgra s+t+was mtshan// shar lhor nor bdag mnan pa'i ri khrod ma// ston zla'i zhal mnga' dgra bcom 'khar gsil 'chang*// lho nub bden pa bral bar gtum mo sngo// 'khor lo thong gshol dag gis phyag zung mdzes// nub byang thags bzangs ris gnas g.yung mo ni// dbang gzhu ltar bkra rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsgreng*// lha mo de dag skyil krung phyed pa'i zhabs// gar gyi stabs mdzad thod phreng rus pas brgyan// khro chags nyams ldan gtso 'khor thams cad kyang*// rab 'bar ye shes me yi klong na bzhengs// gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i lha// rdo rje gur dang rdo rje dbyings la sogs// dgyes rdor rtsa bshad rgyud gsum lha tshogs dang*// bde gsang 'jigs sogs yi dam lha yis bskor// steng phyogs bka' babs rnam bzhi'i bla ma dang*// 'og phyogs gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi sogs// bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde tshogs bsgos pa'i bka'// tshul bzhin sgrub la spro bas 'khod par gsal// bsang mchod stob pa ni/

oṃ rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams stobs dag dang*// rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung bden pa'i mthus// dngos bshams yid byung mchod sprin bskal pa'i srid// yon gnas yongs kyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /kye 'pho med dga' bde'i yon tan gya nom la// dgyes dgur spyod pa'i dbang po khyed cag rnams// kun rtog ser sna'i 'ching bas nongs gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i yo byad phal gyis ci ste phongs// 'on te bdag sogs bsod nams tshogs phyir dang*// sgo gsum nyes brgya'i dri ma sbyang slad du// bsang mchod 'dod pa'i longs spyod stob pa la// dgyes par rol de smon lam mthu yin phyir// mchod yon rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng chal chil g.yo// thang dang chu skyes me tog ge sar 'dzum// spos mchog bsung gi sprin sngon mkha' la dkrigs// sgron me'i phreng bas nyin byed 'od la 'thab// dri chab rdzing bu'i rlabs kyi zegs ma 'thor// ro drug bcud ldan bza' bca'i zhal zas bstar// sil snyan gling bu'i dbyangs kyis zhing khams bkang*// rag pas bde ster lha yi gos mchog bklubs// ro nus phun sum tshogs pa'i ba lin+ta// stong gsum srid pa'i sa gzhi rgya mtsho dang*// lhun po ri gling snang byed zung gis 'khyud// mi mchog sku la rdzogs pa'i dge mtshan brgyad// sa bdag skal bas thob pa'i rin chen bdun// ci 'dod nyams su bstar ba'i nye ba bdun// sna tshogs nor bu gser dngul ja dar gos// srung ba'i go khrab gcod 'bigs mtshon gyi rigs// 'gro mgyogs rta drel gnag phyugs rnam pa mang*// yid 'phrog mig can ri dwags spang rir rtse// spu sdug bya rigs stong pa'i mkha' la lding*// mche sder rtsal gyis dregs pa'i gcan gzan sogs// lha mi gdengs can yul gyi nyer spyad rigs// dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar gangs ri'i spun// bdud rtsi rgya ja'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// nad 'joms sman dang lha shing bzang ngo cog

/bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dod yon lnga yi skyes// lha yi rdzing ring kun du khyab par khyer// gcig tu nyams chags nyes ltung sgrib pa'i tshogs// sbyong byed mchod pa'i yongs rtse 'di dag ni// gsang rgyud spyi dang khyad par kye rdo rje'i// dbang rgyud man ngag zab mo dngos dang brgyud// legs 'doms rdo rje 'chang dang bdag med ma// bi rū pa sogs bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi gzhi// rgyu thabs 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum dbyer med pa'i// snying po dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu dang*// rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs 'byung por bcas// mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer lnga ldan rdo rje gur// rigs bsdus rigs rkyang rdo rje dbyings la sogs// rgyud chen gsum gyis nges bstan lha yis mtshon// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun la 'bul// rdo rje theg pa'i bshad sgrub bdud rtsi'i ro'i// dga' ston rgyas par spel zhing skyong ba por// gnyis med gsung gi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// dmag zor dur khrod yab yum bran bdud sogs// bstan dgra yongs kyi srog dbugs la dgyes pa'i// rgyud gsum dregs pa'i 'khor lor 'bul gyi bzhes// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ kye thugs rje che dgongs bdag cag rgyu sbyor gyi// sgo gsum rdzing bu las nyon glang po yis// mngon par dkrugs pa'i nyes ltung rnyog ma rnams// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i nor bus bgrung du gsol// so thar khrims kyi zhing sa gshin pa la// rgyal sras spyod pa'i myu gu'i phreng ba 'khrigs// rim gnyis rtogs pa'i snye ma stobs bdo bar// grub pa zung gi 'bras bu phun tshogs mdzod// bla ma'i tshogs kyis de ltar bdag byin rlobs// lhag pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum ston// srung ma rgya mtshos bar chad kun bsal te// gang bsam phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod// gangs can spyi dang bye brag yul ljongs 'dir// e waṃ pa yi lugs mchog rgya mtsho'i rjes// slob pa'i ngur smrig 'chang ba grangs med dag

/'dus pa'i khur gyis nor 'dzin mdzes gyur cig /ces kye rdo rje rgyud gsum lha tshogs srung mar bcas pa'i bsang tshul rdo rje glu ma'i dbyangs mchod ces bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen yangs dge slong dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'dun pa ma bskyud tsam gyi btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis dkar po'i gnam lo gsar tshes su bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod bya ba'i yi ge bzhugs// ༄༅// bka' drin gzhal dka'i mnyam med bla ma dang*// dbyer med rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud nas// de mnyes byed pa'i bsang mchod sprin phung las// 'ongs pa'i dngos grub char rgyun 'di na 'bebs// 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas la bsang mchod mos pas mchod gtor phud skyems sman spos la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i bsang rdzas legs par bshams la ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsang rdzas rgya mtsho mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// rab 'byams rgya mtsho mchod pa'i bye brag rnams// mchod 'os rgya mtsho kun gyi spyan lam du// mi zad rgya mtsho mkha' dang mnyam par gyur// chos dbyings spros bral ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa gshin rje'i gshed// bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas kun spyan 'dren na// 'dir gshegs so so'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs// hūm̐ sna tshogs pad nyi ye shes me dpung klong*// 'jam dpal khros pa'i gar sgyur zhal dgu pa// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha du mas sgeg pa'i phyag /sum cu rtsa bzhi ldan pa'i mthing nag sku// brkyang bskum bcu drug zhabs kyis tshangs sogs dang*// srog chags brgyad brgyad mnan zhing mtshan ma bsgreng*// zhal gdangs ljags bsgril mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs// nyi zla 'bum gyi gzi 'phrog nyer bdun spyan// sma ra smin ma kham ser ral pa yis// mtshams sprin gsar pa'i mdangs la 'gran pa bzhin// dur khrod rgyan sogs 'jigs pa'i chas rnams rdzogs// ma he'i gdong can khro bo kun gyi gtso// khyod kyi rnam 'phrul 'jig rten tshul 'dzin pa'i// phyogs skyong bcu dang rab 'byams 'khor gyi tshogs// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i dam tshig can// las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas rnams la// mthun pa'i dam rdzas mtshan ldan ka pā la'i// snod du ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i// mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed tshar du dngar// dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor ma bdud rtsi'i mtsho// ja chang phye mar 'bru sna gtsang ma'i phud// sman spos sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dri zhim sprin// lha lam gang bar dngos bshams yid sprul 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do dges pas bzhes su gsol// de ltar khyed mchod bstod pa'i byin rlabs mthus// rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen zhi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad stsol// bka' 'khor dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mnyes nas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan dang de 'dzin sku tshe sogs// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod// mdor na sgrub po yon mchod ma lus pa'i// phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad mun pa'i dpung*// byin nus nyin byed stobs kyis zhi ba dang*// rtag tu bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun// thams cad gnas 'dir bkra shis g.yang du stsol// dngos 'byor yid sprul dgyes phyir mchod pa la// rmongs pa'i dbang gis 'khrul pa ji snyed bshags// mdun gyi nam mkhar snang stong 'ja' tshon ltar// dmigs te bos pa'i mgron rnams rang gnas gshegs// 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur stsol bla ma dang*// yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog

/ces pa 'di ni yi dam 'di nyid kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i dge bshes bsod nams rab brtan dang sangs rgyas dpal ldan dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ phran bu ming ā nan+da puṇ+yar bod pas bris par 'gal 'khrul mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs rnams la bshags shing dge bas 'gro ba kun la phan par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// lha mo 'od zer can ma'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga bde legs dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang sku bsgom zhing gsang sngags bzlas tsam gyis// bar chad 'jigs pa kun las rgyang bsrings nas// bde legs dpal ster bla ma 'od zer can// thal sbyar gyis btud de yi bsang mchod 'dri// 'di'i bsang mchod la bsang rdzas mchod pa spyi ltar bsham/ bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*/ ma 'brel ba'i tshe skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi tshig gang rigs sngon du btang nas/ mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang gsum yi ges sbyangs spel legs sbyar ba'i// 'dod yon gya nom 'jo ba'i dud sprin dang*// lha rdzas mchod pa dwangs gsal ye shes kyi// snang bas nam mkha'i khams kun khyab gyur cig /spyan 'dren pa ni/ kye bdag nyid lhar gsal sa bon 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras 'khor bcas pa rnams// mtshar sdug lha mo'i gar gyis mchog stsol ba'i// 'od zer can ma'i rnam pas gnas 'dir gshegs// gsal gdab pa ni/ nam mkhar khab spu ldan pa phag pa'i steng*// chu skyes pad+ma'i gdan la mnyam bzhengs pa'i// bde gshegs rigs mchog lha mo 'od zer can// gser gyi mdog can dar bab 'jo sgeg gzugs// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin brkyang bas ci 'dod dngos// sbyin pas dpag bsam gtong ba phra mor byed// cig shos mya ngan med pa'i yal ga yis// 'jigs pas nyen la mi 'jigs dbugs rab 'byin// dngos grub btung ba 'dod 'jo'i nu ma mtho// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen brgyan ma la// dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam rig sngags lhas// steng phyogs 'khor yug kun nas bskor bar gsal// bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/

kye khyed rnams dgyes phyir mchod pa 'bul ba ni// me tog spos dang snang gsal dri chab bshos// gzugs mchog sgra snyan dri zhim ro mchog gos// dkar mngar phye mar phung po ja bzang phud// dbyig 'dzin bu mo'i dbyar gyi dus ston du// rnam par bskrun pa'i dbyar skyes sdong bu dang*// lo 'dab gzhon nu gtul ba'i dri zhim sprin// dag byed 'dod yon mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /dngos grub zhu ba ni/ kye bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po mi phyugs bcas// gzhir sdod byes su bgrod sogs rnam pa kun// nad gdon bar chad 'jigs pa kun bsal nas// mi 'byung srung ba'i gur nang ngal gsor byin// zhi bas gdul min dgra jag chom kun rigs// grangs med sprul pa'i lha mo'i khab skud kyis// kha mig yan lag btsems nas phag rgod las// sprul pa'i phag pas sa 'og 'ching bar mdzod// gzhan don sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i bsod nams tshe// gang gā'i rgyun ring lta bur bsring ba dang*// dpal 'byor legs pa'i yon tan dbyar dus kyi// rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin du rgyas par mdzod// khyed kyi thugs rje thogs med rkang drug gis// 'khor 'das pad+ma'i skyed tshal ji snyed las// dge legs 'byor pa'i ro mngar kun bsdus nas// gnas 'dir bkra shis rgyas pa'i g.yang du stsol// don dam klong du gshegs bzhud mi mnga' la// kun rdzob sgyu ma'i gshegs tshul ston na yang*// khyod mtshan brjod pa'i mod la smon lam mthus// 'bral med 'grogs pa'i srung skyob dam pa mdzod// ces lha mo 'od zer can ma'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga bde legs dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'tsho byed kyi gtsug lag 'chang ba lha khos bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i zla ba gro bzhin gyi 'grub sbyor 'dzom par lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga ḍā ki dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun skyed shes rab pha rol phyin// bdud dpung gdul phyir drag mo'i skur bstan nas// las bzhi lhun grub ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// bsang mchod mgron du 'gugs pa'i cho ga brtsam// 'dir ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can mar bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ bsang rdzas ci 'byor pa spyi ltar bsags/ spro na smug rtsis byugs pa'i dpal bshos rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig kyang bshams nas/ mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ bshams pa'i dngos rdzas mi dmigs stong nyid kyi// rang gdangs 'gag med dag byed mchod pa'i sprin// 'dod pa'i yon tan 'dzad med sgyu ma'i mdzod// mchod yul dgyes pa'i mthu dang ldan gyur cig /spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ mkha' spyod gnas dang dur khrod yul chen sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros yongs bskor ba// 'dir gshegs so sor 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ mdun gyi nam mkhar me dpung 'bar klong du// seng ge khros pa'i zhal mnga' mthon mthing mdog /gdug can mgo bo gcod pa'i gri gug g.yas// cig shos dam nyams khrag dron gtams pa'i snod// stag sham mgo phreng rus pa'i rgyan gyes brgyan// chu skyes nyin byed dgra bgegs ro yi steng*// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa'i gar stabs bzhengs// mi phyed rdo rjes spyi bor brgyan ma la// dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// ye shes srid pa'i mkha' 'gros bskor bar gsal// mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kye khyed rnams mthun pa'i mchod sprin 'bul ba ni// mchod yon rgya mtsho bgrod byed bsil ba'i chab// me tog dga' tshal grangs med dri zhim spos// mun sel sgron ma'i phreng ba dri chab rgyun// ro bcud nus pa phun tshogs zhal zas che// gzugs sdug mig gi dpyid gyur rnar snyan sgra// snom byed tshim pa'i dri dang ro drug bcud// dro 'jam bde ster gos dang chos dbyings bde// ja chang rgya mtsho phye mar gangs ri'i spun// lhan cig skyes sbyar spos shing bsregs pa'i sprin// 'dod pa'i yon tan gya nom spro ba la// legs bris bdag po'i bang mdzod phye 'dra 'dis// byin rlabs gdams pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bsgom bzlas tsam gyis bsrung bzlog bsad pa sogs// thogs med 'grub pa'i dpa' mo seng gdong can// rnam lnga'i rigs can ye shes 'jig rten pa'i// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i 'khor du bcas pa rnams// bsang ngo mchod do bdag dang yon sbyor gyi// sdig ltung nyes pa'i grib kun sbyang du gsol// gtor ma yod na/

gtor snod thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i rnam pa la/ ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rtsa sngags 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i mthar/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma rigs lngas mtshon pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi bar chad bzlog pa dang*/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba dang*/ las bzhi'i dngos grub thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol lo// zhes pa'i bar gtor ma med na mi dgos so// dngos grub zhu ba ni/ kye khyed thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzam bu rkang 'thung las// bdag cag sbyin bdag mos pa'i ma dros mtshor// dngos grub snye ma smin pa'i dga' ston bzang*// bsam kun 'grub pa'i gser du bsgyur mdzod cig /ma mo 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs dug /mi bzad nad rims dus min 'chi ba'i rigs// snang byed 'od kyis mun pa ltar bcil nas// mthu stobs srung ba'i rwa bar chud par mdzod// phrag dog sdang sems dug chus cher myos pa// gzhan sdes brtsams pa'i byad gtad 'khrul 'khor gyi// gnod pa thams cad phyir bzlog byad ma dngos// las ngan rten bcas brlag pa'i gshed du sgyur// gsang gsum bsgom bzlas lhur len rnal 'byor pa// ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams dbyig /lung rtogs yon tan rnam dkar phrin las rnams// dkar phyogs zla ba bzhin du rgyas par mdzod// khyed kyi thugs rje nus pa'i shing rtar brten// chos srid dpal 'byor mnga' thang phun tshogs kyi// phywa g.yang thams cad tshur bsdus sbyin pa'i bdag

/bde legs rnam par 'phel ba'i skyes su stsol// zhes ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga ḍā kī dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'tsho byed kyi gzhung lugs 'chang ba lha khos bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu grub par bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// jo bo rje'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig mgron du gnyer ba'i bsang mchod dga' ston gzhun nu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rnam 'dren yongs kyi bya grub ye shes khams// bcu drug bgrang bya'i nyams ldan sgeg mo'i skur// mngon par sprul pa'i bla ma rje btsun mar// thal sbyar gyis btud de yi bsang mchod 'dri// phrin las sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bsang mchod bya bas/ bsang rdzas ci 'byor bsham/ spos shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa gtul zhing 'di skad do// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ spyan 'dren pa/ kye bdag nyid 'phags mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas// phyogs bcur 'od kyi pho nya spros ma thag /rang bzhin gnas dang po ta la ri nas// rgyal ba kun yum 'khor ba sgrol mdzad ma// phrin las lha mo nyer gcig bcas pa la// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// mchod 'os rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan 'dren na// 'dir gshegs chu skyes zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// gsal gdab pa/ kye mdun gyi mkha' dkyil me long gzugs brnyan ltar// snang stong gnyis su med pa'i yid 'phrog gzugs// sngo ljang mtshan bzang lang tsho dar bab ma// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'dod 'jo'i nu 'bur mtho// margad 'khri shing brkyangs 'dra'i phyag g.yas kyis// mchog sbyin phyag rgyas ci 'dod dngos grub ster// g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas ut+pa la'i// sdong bu snyan drung 'dab stong grol ba bsnams// mthon mthing ral pa'i cod paṇa bcings pa'i khrod// pad+ma'i rigs mchog bde bar gshegs pas brgyan// dbang gzhu'i lang tshor co 'dra'i dar gos dang*// rin chen rgyan phreng 'thab pa'i sgra snyan 'khrol// brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis// chu skyes zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la rol// 'khor du phrin las lha mo nyi shu gcig

/gzhan don zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// sgrub pa'i rjes mthun kha dog tha dad la// dar bab lang tshor rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan// g.yas pa'i phyag rnams mchog sbyin brkyangs pa'i mthil// dngos grub rjes su mthun pa'i bum pa bzang*// cig shos ut+pal sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la g.yas rol bzhugs// de dag steng char rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// bar du yi dam sangs rgyas sems dpa'i tshogs// 'og gi cha la bstan srung nor lha dang*// gzhi bdag lam lhar bcas pa gsal bar 'khod// bsang mchod 'bul ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa'i dngos rnams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gyi// yi ges dag pa ye shes rang snang du// mchod yul dgyes pa'i 'dod yon byin brlabs pas// mchod sprin mi zad bskal par 'byung gyur cig /srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol lha mo 'khor bcas la// 'jig rten khams kyi mchod yon me tog spos// mar me byug pa zhal zas sgra snyan dbyangs// rgyal srid bdun dang shis pa'i rtags brgyad dang*// gser dngul ja bzang gos dar 'bru rigs dang*// dbyar skyes lcug phran lo 'dab me tog dang*// 'bras bu dri ro bzang dgu gtul ba'i sprin// zhing kun bgrod pa'i dag byed bsang mchod 'di// dbang bskur byin rlabs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol rgyal ba'i phrin las ma// yi dam rgyal ba rgyal sras srung ma dang*// dkar phyogs skyong bcas bsang zhing mchod pa 'bul// bstod pa/ gang mtshan 'dzin nam dran pas bar chad dang*// 'jigs pa kun las skyob par zhal gyis 'ches// thugs rje myur mar rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// kun gyis bsngags pa rje btsun sgrol mar bstod// dngos grub zhu ba/ mchod 'bul 'di bzhes bdag cag sbyin bdag tshogs// byes bgrod gzhir gnas byang chub sgrub pa'i skabs// rnam kun bar chad 'jigs tshogs thams cad las// skyob byed thugs rje'i phyag ring brkyang bar mdzod// ri dwags rgyal po gnyis 'thung chom rkun me// sbrul gdug khri mun chu bo 'byung po yi// 'jigs pa kun la khyod mtshan dran pa'i 'phral// 'jigs med gnas su phyin ltar zhi bar mdzod// brtson pa'i grur zhugs snying rje'i ba dan bskyod// byang chub sems gnyis mthun pa'i rlung 'gros kyis// tshogs gnyis spyod pa'i chu gter brgal nas ni// sku gsum yon tan nor bur dbang 'byor shog

/'phags ma'i thugs rjes de srid skye ba'i phreng*// dal 'byor lus thob thos bsam bsgom par brtson// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs yongs rig nas// bstan la mkhas pa'i bya ba byed por mdzod// 'phags ma dgyes pa'i phrin las zur mig gis// che btsan mkhas dgu'i yid dbang rab phrogs nas// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor tshur bsdus gnas 'di ru// phywa g.yang dngos grub 'phel ba'i bkra shis stsol// bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel bar gshegs gsol dgos pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra mu zhes pas bsang mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'phags ma sgrol ma dgyes 'dzum dmul ba'i slad// 'phags ma mgron gnyer dga' ston gzhon nu 'di// 'phags mar dad pa'i dge slong tshul khrims ngor// 'phags sras tshul khrims rin chen can gyis bris// sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// //bsngo ba mdor bsdus ni/ mchod sbyin rgya chen bstabs pa'i bsod nams kyis// sbyin bzhi'i pha rol phyin mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas// bdag gis thob nas khams gsum sems can rnams// theg gsum chos kyi mgron du gnyer bar shog /ces bsang mchod phul ba la sogs pa'i mjug tu dge ba bsngo ba mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
